name: smwmusic-touhou-mukyuushi-glory-of-deep-skies-records-of-an-unreadable-name
title: Touhou Mukyuushi ~ Glory of Deep Skies - Records of an Unreadable Name
description:
The player's score theme from Glory of Deep Skies, a Touhou fangame.

It's a solemn and repetitive song that feels very cozy to listen to. I took some slight liberties with instrumentation to capture the vibe of the song better within the context of SMW.

Includes an option to disable the fade-in by changing a define.
